fomod.Name: Magic Tattoos Framework
fomod.Author: levchimik
fomod.Description:
Skyrim SE/AE framework for dynamic, condition-driven tattoo overlays with gameplay effects.
This installer bundles: - Magic Tattoos Framework (core engine, MCM, MTFPulse SKSE DLL) - 7 integration plugins (Fertility Mode Reloaded, OSL Aroused, SexLab, OStim, Beeing Female NG, SlaveTats, SkyrimNet) - 4 JSON catalogs for popular overlay packs (LewdMarks, RX Overlays, Bard's Nail Overlays, Community Overlays 1) - Optional: NPC overlays helper (skee64_custom.ini bPlayerOnly=0), Test Pack (smoke-test presets)
Integration plugins auto-detect their target master plugin — only those whose dependencies are installed will be selectable.
Content packs ship the JSON catalog only; you must install the source mod separately for textures.
Hard requirements (NOT auto-checked): RaceMenu/SKEE, PapyrusUtil, SKSE 64.
